outcome: Low APGAR scores at 1 and 5 minutes
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 1037 obese pregnant women who delivered in the last five years attending King Abdulaziz University Hospital, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
finding: Maternal obesity was significantly associated with adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, cesarean section, low APGAR scores, and neonatal complications.
birth_weight: Neonates of obese mothers had significantly lower birth weights
